items.title: The Thunder Gate
items.task: Find the enormous lantern. Then look underneath it. What detail do most visitors miss?
items.notes: Do not print the missed detail in the hook. Keep it for the family.

items.title: Temple + Shopping?
items.question: Why would a busy shopping street grow directly in front of a temple?
items.reveal: Pilgrims brought crowds. Crowds brought merchants.

moreInfo.title: The road to the temple
moreInfo.text: In Edo, people travelled to Sensō-ji. Shops grew along the last stretch because the visitors were already walking there.

items.notes: Check how old Nakamise is as a named street before live.

items.title: Why Is Everyone Waving Smoke?
items.task: Watch what people do with the incense smoke. What do you think it means?
items.reveal: Some people waft the smoke toward a part of the body as a blessing. It is a folk practice, not medicine.
items.notes: Do not claim medical effect. Confirm the usual explanation before live.
